title: tine-event/1
description: One remote event (the `data:` of an SSE frame on `GET /v1/tenants/<t>/events`, and the `event` of a webhook payload) or, from `tine watch` on a local repository, one op-log entry (`op.logged`, tenant null). `data` by kind: `ref.updated` {name, old, new, forced}; `run.created` {runs (at most 100 oids), total}; `log.checkpoint` {origin, size, root}; `op.logged` an opentine-op/1 entry.
